overview: The Medford City Council adopted the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District zoning amendments and ordained a new Public Tree Ordinance. The Council also approved a resolution supporting legal intervention in the Chertok litigation and called for the immediate release of resident Vijay D'Souza from ICE detention.

items.title: Ward 1 Neighborhood Meeting Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting Ward 1 residents to a neighborhood meeting on September 23rd at Andrews Middle School.

items.title: National Recovery Month Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating National Recovery Month and highlighting city recovery support services.

items.title: Remembrance of Lorraine Marie Miles
items.summary: Passed a resolution expressing condolences and observing a moment of silence in memory of retired educator Lorraine Marie Miles.

items.title: Committee Reports and Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved past meeting records and committee reports concerning affordable housing linkage fees and resident engagement newsletters.

items.title: West Medford Train Station Safety Improvements
items.summary: Referred a resolution regarding safety upgrades and procurement timelines for the West Medford train station to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses for Ebisuya and Moussey and Co.
items.summary: Approved common victualler's licenses for Ebisuya and Moussey and Co.

items.title: Rosso's Grill Common Victualler License
items.summary: Tabled and later approved a common victualler's license for Rosso's Grill under new ownership.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Trees Medford Plantings
items.summary: Approved a Community Preservation Act appropriation of $8,500 to Trees Medford for the Berry Park College Avenue Plantings Project.

items.title: Support for Release of Vijay D'Souza
items.summary: Passed a resolution calling for the immediate release of Medford resident Vijay D'Souza from ICE detention.

items.title: Boston Avenue Rezoning Amendments
items.summary: Ordained the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District zoning amendments after reconsideration, setting a 10-foot step back and permitting purpose-built student housing by right.

items.title: Support for Legal Intervention in Chertok Litigation
items.summary: Passed a resolution adopting a declaration of support for resident or Attorney General intervention in the Chertok litigation to defend the city's values-based investment ordinance.

items.title: Public Tree Ordinance Adoption
items.summary: Waived three readings and ordained the Public Tree Ordinance to protect and regulate city-owned trees on public lands.

items.title: Law Department Appropriations Review
items.summary: Tabled the discussion and administrative response regarding Law Department appropriations and legal expenditure reporting.

items.title: Police Chief Hiring Committee Appointment
items.summary: Appointed Vice President Emily Lazzaro to the police chief interview panel and requested a public meeting to outline the hiring process.

items.title: Clarification on Building Height Definition
items.summary: Approved a resolution to clarify and record the adoption status of the building height definition change passed on April 28, 2026.

items.title: Chapter 40U Fine Enforcement Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution to accept General Law Chapter 40U to establish a tax roll fine collection system to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Private Ways Communications and Responsibilities
items.summary: Referred a resolution to draft a communications plan on private ways responsibilities to the Public Health and Community Safety Committee.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved appointments and reappointments to several municipal boards and commissions.

items.title: Sentry Ford Settlement Approval
items.summary: Approved an $11,640 settlement with Sentry Ford for property damage caused by a DPW vehicle.
